mapper.select: select policy_id, tenant_id, dept_id, identity_mode, allow_anonymous, allow_member_without_phone, status from mem_identity_policy where tenant_id = #{tenantId} and dept_id = #{deptId} and status = '1' limit 1
mapper.insert: insert into mem_identity_policy (tenant_id, dept_id, identity_mode, allow_anonymous, allow_member_without_phone, status, create_by, create_time, update_by, update_time) values (#{tenantId}, #{deptId}, #{identityMode}, #{allowAnonymous}, #{allowMemberWithoutPhone}, '1', #{createBy}, sysdate(), #{updateBy}, sysdate())
mapper.update: update mem_identity_policy set identity_mode = #{identityMode}, allow_anonymous = #{allowAnonymous}, allow_member_without_phone = #{allowMemberWithoutPhone}, status = '1', update_by = #{updateBy}, update_time = sysdate() where policy_id = #{policyId} and tenant_id = #{tenantId} and dept_id = #{deptId}
